Name: Bachelor and Bachelorettes all portraits
Author: UsernamesLogin
Description:
Has the bachelors and bachelorettes with all there little expressions and event images. Makes the people look different. They are made to match the original sprites mostly.

This has been [b]updated[/b] because Sebastian had wrong expressions and would not blush. Please download and replace to fix.

There is now an optional download that has some random townspeople! Wow.

Portraits go in the "Content\" directory of your stardew valley install directory. You overwrite the files. Backup before you do this.

Original forum post: http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/bachelor-and-bachelorette-all-portraits.109109/
